newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt bidders to make statement.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt bidders to make statement.

text.p: The Austro-Italian-German consortium bidding for privatisation candidate Creditanstalt-Bankverein will make a statement on Friday outlining its stance, a source in the consortium said.
"We will issue a statement in the course of the day outlining our basic position, but there will be no exact details," the source told Reuters.
The source declined to say when the consortium, led by Austro-Italian insurer EA Generali, would issue the statement or specify its contents.
Friday midnight is the deadline set by Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima for a firm offer from the consortium.
A spokesman for the Vienna Bourse said he could not rule out suspension of Creditanstalt's shares should the statement be price sensitive. -- Vienna newsroom +43 1 531 12 257
